'''Sammana''' was a [[Wise One]] [[Dreamer]] from [[Bair]]'s youth. Her name is mentioned with reference to [[Mesaana]]'s fate.{{ref/book|13|38}}

== Activities ==
While in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' she encountered something that broke her mind. She lives the rest of her life drooling and incontinent, only able to speak at the level of a toddler.
